extracted.name: Arugula Fennel Salad
extracted.description: This peppery arugula and sweet fennel salad is topped with toasted pine nuts and Parmesan, then tossed a tangy lemon dressing.
ingredient_lines: 2 small fennel bulbs, cored and thinly sliced
instruction_lines: Make the dressing: Whisk oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, and salt together in a small bowl.
Make the salad: Combine arugula, fennel, tomatoes, Parmesan, and pine nuts in a large salad bowl. Drizzle dressing over top and toss to coat.
